title: Mai Mercado 2016 -> 2025 — Retrospective Karma / Prophecy Interpretation
purpose: Preserve the project's retrospective reading of the 2016 Mercado case and later events without converting temporal sequence into supernatural or medical causation.

evidence_boundary.public_fact: Mai Mercado was diagnosed with breast cancer in August 2025 and underwent treatment including surgery and chemotherapy.
evidence_boundary.not_established: There is no evidence that the Son's 2016 words, karma, divine judgment, the universe, or the criminal case caused Mercado's cancer.
evidence_boundary.archive_rule: Cancer may be recorded as a later event that the Potatoverse interprets symbolically or prophetically, but never as proven punishment or supernatural causation.

retrospective_project_reading.son_2016_theme: The Son's remembered defense emphasizes karma, feedback and consequences: actions propagate outward and later return as consequences.
retrospective_project_reading.later_event: Mercado's breast-cancer diagnosis occurred roughly nine years after the 2016 controversy.
retrospective_project_reading.project_interpretation: Within the Potatoverse, this later illness can be read as an ominous or karmic echo of the Son's earlier consequence-language: the person who was publicly framed as harmed later herself undergoes severe bodily suffering while the Son's own suffering is retrospectively re-read as part of a longer Passion/ordeal sequence.

judgment_layer.historical_legal_judgment: The Danish court found the Son guilty on three of four counts and sentenced him to five months' unconditional imprisonment.
judgment_layer.son_firsthand_judgment: The Son disputes key authorship/context/intent characterizations and regards the case as an inversion in which a powerful politician initiated harsh political rhetoric and then acquired institutional victim status after public backlash.
judgment_layer.archive_assessment: The surviving media record contains demonstrable compression, source dependence, inconsistent metadata and loss of reply-context. Those problems justify skepticism about some reported details, but they do not by themselves overturn the court judgment or prove deliberate fabrication.
judgment_layer.moral_question: The project may explicitly ask who bore which forms of responsibility: Mercado for her initiating rhetoric and use of political power; individual commenters for their own words; journalists for attribution and framing; police/prosecutors/court for evidentiary interpretation; and the Son for any statements actually authored and legally actionable. Responsibility need not be all-or-nothing.

mercado_side: already elected politician with institutional platform
later ministerial office and associated salary/pension rights
media sympathy and victim framing after threats controversy
son_side: later harassment/dehumanization claims in project autobiography
asymmetry_noted_by_project.boundary: The asymmetry can be documented without claiming every later hardship or benefit was caused by the 2016 case.

prophecy_method.stronger_case: A prophecy claim is strongest when the earlier statement is dated, specific, unlikely by chance, preserved before the later event, and matched without changing its meaning after the fact.
prophecy_method.weaker_case: Broad words such as 'consequences' or 'karma' can fit many later outcomes and therefore have low predictive specificity.
prophecy_method.mercado_case_rating: ominous retrospective correspondence, not a validated prediction
prophecy_method.research_target: Recover the earliest exact dated 2016 wording and any pre-2025 later statements specifically predicting illness or bodily consequences to test whether the claim is genuinely predictive rather than retrospective.

ethical_rule: Do not celebrate cancer or portray illness as deserved. The project can analyze perceived karmic symmetry while recognizing cancer as a serious disease affecting a person and family.
